verdict.rationale: The evidence never says whether My DOR's online flow has an operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout, or that any such limits are published before a founder starts. The 24/7 availability claim applies to the automated phone line, not the online portal. Draft saving is an adjacent feature and does not disclose limits. The probe could not see the authenticated portal, so the evidence cannot show these constraints being disclosed up front.
